side_effects.context: - **I did not run a plain `pytest`.** `tests/conftest.py` has an autouse fixture that loads customers from `settings.database_path()`. That defaults to `data/customers.db`, the production PII database AGENTS.md says never to access. Instead I built a 50-row synthetic database at `/tmp/custdesk_sample.db` and ran `CUSTDESK_DB=/tmp/custdesk_sample.db pytest`.
